missions.title: Dawn Run
missions.place: The Line's camp and the dock roofs
missions.beat: Dawn at the Line's camp: Echo hands Parker the insulin for the Okafor kid. On the way back the radio cuts out, smoke climbs off the camp roof and a Static pickup pulls away up the quay with Echo in the back. The Host is on every radio: the hunt is on.
missions.enemies: None. The raid is seen, not fought.

missions.title: The Yard
missions.place: Mags's yard and the container terminal
missions.beat: Mags makes Parker run the yard once and hands him his granddad's pistol on the way past. Out through the south gate, Warehouse Row and the tower ahead.
missions.moves: Flips, 360s, lean and side flip; combos

missions.title: On Air
missions.beat: First ambush. The Host names Parker on air and starts calling the run.
missions.enemies: Gunners; slow-mo as an adrenaline burst

missions.title: Glass District
missions.beat: Through a Static toll tower, floor by floor.

missions.title: Silt Line
missions.beat: The Host blows a bridge and drops Parker into the Silt. Climb back up through the Hollows before the dust gets to you.

missions.title: Meridian Mall
missions.place: The atrium, the north wing and Hargrove and Sons
missions.beat: The Static have made the mall the Host's arena. He outs Mags on air as his old producer, Juno paces Parker along the far walkway, and in the store's electronics floor every screen lights up: Echo is alive.
missions.moves: Escalators, walkways over the voids, the store well; speed gates
missions.enemies: Crawlers, leapers and a brute; bruisers and a spotter drone

missions.title: Parking Spiral
missions.beat: Juno, the Static's star hunter and an old Line courier, waits on the car park's top deck. Chase her down the spiral to a duel.
missions.moves: Ramp slides, the running loop, everything at speed

missions.title: Storm Channels
missions.beat: The city starts rooting for Parker. Listeners leave orange marks and open shortcuts.

missions.title: Rail Bridge
missions.beat: The Host changes the route live, sending everything he has.
missions.enemies: Ward squads, marksmen and gun drones; Static gunners

missions.title: Head Office
missions.place: Calder House, lobby to the executive floor
missions.beat: For the first time the Host is in the room. He comes down to deal with Parker himself, shoots from the balconies and runs every time Parker gets close.
missions.moves: Kick doors, jump the glass, slide the shutters
missions.enemies: The Host (hit him for a bonus); the Static on the office floors, the Ward in the atrium

missions.title: Skybridge
missions.place: Calder House top floors and the bridge to the tower
missions.beat: Up through the tape archive to the roof. Parker reaches Echo on the skybridge, and for a few seconds they're face to face. Then the Ward drag her into the tower and blow the bridge.
missions.moves: Shaft wallruns, tank tops, the CALDER sign
missions.enemies: Static hunters in the archive; Ward squads and rifles on the roof

missions.title: The Climb
missions.beat: Straight up the tower while the Host counts down.

missions.title: Dead Air
missions.beat: Parker fights through the Host's crew and reaches Echo, but the Host's last trap pins Parker and sets the tower burning.
missions.enemies: Ward heavies and the Host's elite crew

missions.title: Signal Out
missions.place: Down the burning tower and across the roofs
missions.beat: You play Echo, and for the first time you are the one being chased. She runs to draw the Host away from Parker; he hunts her himself, calling it live. Slow down and he catches her.
missions.enemies: The Host as a pursuing boss
